message: The other day, I realized I hadn’t checked our smoke alarms in ages. So, I decided to make it a little family event! I gathered the kids in the kitchen, we tested the alarms, and turned it into a mini celebration with hot cocoa afterward. ☕ It felt good to be proactive, and it turned a mundane task into some cozy family time. Plus, everyone knows how to escape if we ever need to! Who knew fire safety could be so warm and fuzzy?
